request.query: query SchemaTransaction($name: String!) { __type(name:$name) { name fields { name description type { kind name ofType { kind name } } args { name type { kind name ofType { kind name } } } } } }

fields.name: id
fields.description: The transaction's globally unique identifier, which can be passed to `Query.node` to refetch it.

fields.name: digest
fields.description: A 32-byte hash that uniquely identifies the transaction contents, encoded in Base58.

fields.name: effects
fields.description: The results to the chain of executing this transaction.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The type of this transaction as well as the commands and/or parameters comprising the transaction of this kind.

fields.name: expiration
fields.description: This field is set by senders of a transaction block. It is an epoch reference that sets a deadline after which validators will no longer consider the transaction valid. By default, there is no deadline for when a transaction must execute.

fields.name: gasInput
fields.description: The gas input field provides information on what objects were used as gas as well as the owner of the gas object(s) and information on the gas price and budget.

fields.name: sender
fields.description: The address corresponding to the public key that signed this transaction. System transactions do not have senders.

fields.name: transactionBcs
fields.description: The Base64-encoded BCS serialization of this transaction, as a `TransactionData`.

fields.name: transactionJson
fields.description: The transaction as a JSON blob, matching the gRPC proto format (excluding BCS).
